description: Classifies software-team human/process risk and recommends privacy-preserving, non-clinical interventions without surveillance authority.
when_to_load: When a software-delivery problem may be primarily human, organizational, workload, communication, or collaboration related.
when_not_to_load: Do not load for solo code mechanics, medical diagnosis, covert monitoring, personnel ranking, or implementation authorization.
do_not_regress: Do not diagnose health conditions or attribute motives without evidence.
Do not recommend covert or individual-level productivity surveillance.
Keep optional automation consent-based, transparent, minimal, reversible, and privacy-preserving.
Do not present unsupported productivity ratios or fixed team/process numbers as universal facts.
Delegate technical implementation, validation evidence, terminal, Error Memory, and freeze authority.
